note: The listening page's cast: each character's current voice (cast 14 August, never approved) and alternatives from VCTK speakers nobody else in the cast uses. Picked by accent and gender; VCTK's speakers are 18 to 38, so none is as old as Aldous (61) or Zlata (43).

characters.name: Aldous Vane
characters.line: Mr Novak. Forgive the intrusion. I only came to say how sorry I was about your uncle, and to leave you my card.

characters.name: Danny Ro
characters.who: 26, runs the new crew, grew up three streets away
characters.line: Oi, Novak! Relax, I'm only messing with you. But you tell your uncle's lot the Strip is ours now, yeah?

characters.name: June
characters.line: You look like him. That isn't a compliment. How long have you been sleeping in that office?

characters.name: Zlata
characters.who: 43, runs dispatch at the parcel office, loud laugh, three languages
characters.line: There he is! Where were you yesterday? No, don't tell me, I'll hear it by lunch anyway. The kettle's on.
